tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: How Cue works and how to edit with these tools: concepts, units, track order, workflows and which tool does what. Read it once before editing.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Overview of the open project: canvas, tracks, media, script lines with take status (empty/ok/tight/over), selection and recorder. Call this first. Clips are summarised; use get_timeline for details.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Every clip (id, track, start, duration, source in-point, text, style) optionally limited to a time range.

tools.name: render_frame
tools.description: Render what the viewer sees at a moment as a PNG and return its path, so you can look at the edit (text layout, framing, captions).

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Recent edits with who made them (user or agent).

tools.name: list_recent_projects
tools.description: Recently opened projects.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Every project in the projects overview (recent ones and those in the projects folder) with length, canvas, clip count and last change.

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Save and close the open project, back to the projects overview.

tools.name: save_project_as
tools.description: Save a copy of the project (.cueproj) at a new path and switch to it. Media stays where it is.

tools.name: relink_media
tools.description: Point offline media (moved, renamed or on a disconnected drive; see offlineMedia in get_state) at its new file. Other offline media in the same folder is relinked too.

tools.name: find_offline_media
tools.description: Search near the project (and optionally in extra folders) for offline media that moved, and relink what is found.

tools.name: import_timeline
tools.description: Import an OpenTimelineIO (.otio) timeline from DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, Kdenlive and others as new tracks. Media is linked in place.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a .cueproj project (or a folder containing one; older .cue.json files work too).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project. Optionally start from a video (placed on track V1, canvas matches its size) and a voiceover script from an .srt file or a list of lines.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Rename the project.

tools.name: set_canvas
tools.description: Output size, frame rate and background colour.

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Add video, audio or image files to the media library. With trackId, also place them back to back from startMs.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: The media library: id, kind, duration, origin (import/recording/tts/generated), which line a take belongs to.

tools.name: remove_media
tools.description: Remove a media item and every clip that uses it.

tools.name: add_track
tools.description: Add a video, audio or text track. index 0 is the top.

tools.name: update_track
tools.description: Rename, mute, solo, lock, hide, set volume (0–2) or pan (-1 left to 1 right), mark as the voiceover track, or duck it (lower it automatically while the voiceover speaks).

tools.name: remove_track
tools.description: Delete a track and its clips.

tools.name: move_track
tools.description: Reorder a track (0 = top; upper video tracks draw over lower ones). Video and text tracks always stay above audio tracks.

tools.name: add_clips
tools.description: Place clips. Media clip: {type:'media', trackId, assetId, startMs, durationMs?, inMs?, speed?, volume?, fadeInMs?, fadeOutMs?, transform?}. Text clip: {type:'text', trackId, startMs, durationMs?, text, style?, animationIn?, animationOut?}.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add a title from a template (preset): title, headline, outline, gradient, lower-third, caption, subtitle (yellow outlined), minimal, quote, label or big-number. Style and animations can be changed after with update_clip. Uses the first text track unless trackId is given.

tools.name: update_clip
tools.description: Change a clip: timing, in-point, speed, volume, fades, denoise, color {brightness -1–1, contrast 0–3, saturation 0–3, temperature -1–1, lut: .cube path}, transform (x, y, scale, opacity, crop {left,top,right,bottom} as shares 0–0.45), text, style or animations. mask {shape rectangle|ellipse, x, y, width, height (shares of the picture), feather 0–1, invert} or null. key (chroma key) {color '#00ff00', similarity 0.01–0.6, blend 0–0.5} or null. effects {blur, sharpen, vignette, glow: 0–1, stabilize: boolean} (partial, merged) or null. Text clips: wordStyle {mode highlight|reveal|pop|bounce, color} animates word by word (words are timed from speech for captions, else spread over the clip); words [{text, startMs, endMs}] (clip-local) sets the timing; null clears either. disabled: true keeps it on the timeline but unseen and unheard. label: a colour tag (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink) or null.

tools.name: move_clips
tools.description: Move clips by deltaMs, optionally onto another track.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.description: Move a clip's start or end edge to toMs. Extending is limited by the source media.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.description: Split one clip at a timeline position.

tools.name: split_at
tools.description: Blade: split every clip crossing atMs (optionally only on some tracks).

tools.name: delete_clips
tools.description: Delete clips; ripple closes the gap on their tracks.

tools.name: detach_audio
tools.description: Split a video clip's sound onto its own audio track (the video clip is muted).

tools.name: remove_ranges
tools.description: Cut time ranges out of the timeline on every (or the given) track and close the gaps. Script lines and markers after a range move with it.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: The project's complete history, newest first: every change with its step number, who made it (user, agent or system), when, and on which timeline. It persists across sessions.

inputs.name: after
inputs.note: only steps after this number (what's new)

tools.name: restore_history
tools.description: Bring the project back to how it was right after a history step. This is a new step itself, so it can be undone.

tools.name: list_sequences
tools.description: Every timeline (sequence) in the project, which one is open, and which appear nested inside others.

tools.name: new_sequence
tools.description: Create a timeline (sequence) and open it (open: false keeps the current one open).

tools.name: open_sequence
tools.description: Open another timeline. Editing tools always work on the open one.

tools.name: rename_sequence
tools.description: Rename a timeline.

tools.name: duplicate_sequence
tools.description: Copy a timeline (e.g. to try a different cut).

tools.name: delete_sequence
tools.description: Delete a timeline that is not open and not nested anywhere.

tools.name: nest_clips
tools.description: Nest clips (Premiere's Nest): move them into a new sequence that takes their place as one clip. Open the new sequence to edit inside it; the nested clip updates when you come back.

tools.name: add_adjustment_layer
tools.description: Add an adjustment layer: a clip on a video track whose colour grade (update_clip color) and mask apply to everything on the tracks below it for as long as it lasts. Without trackId it goes on a new top track.

tools.name: speed_ramp
tools.description: Speed ramp part of a media clip (fromMs–toMs in clip time, default all of it): up = ease to peak speed, down = ease from peak back to normal, inOut = fast in the middle (montage), outIn with peak < 1 = slow-motion hit. Later clips on the track move to make room.

tools.name: lift_range
tools.description: Remove everything between two times (the in and out points) but leave the gap, like Premiere's Lift. Use remove_ranges to close the gap (Extract).

tools.name: insert_edit
tools.description: Three-point edit: put a media item's range (inMs–outMs, default whole) on a track at atMs. insert pushes later material along on every unlocked track; overwrite replaces what is there.

tools.name: freeze_frame
tools.description: Hold the frame at atMs (inside a video clip) for durationMs; later clips on that track move along.

tools.name: remove_silence
tools.description: Find pauses in the speech (video and voiceover audio, or given clips) and cut them out across all tracks. keepMs leaves a little air on each side. Use dryRun to preview the ranges first.

tools.name: slip_clip
tools.description: Change which part of the source a clip shows without moving it (deltaMs of source time).

tools.name: roll_edit
tools.description: Move the cut between two adjacent clips on a track to toMs (one gets longer, the other shorter).

tools.name: slide_clip
tools.description: Move a clip between its neighbours; the neighbour before grows and the one after shrinks so nothing else moves.

tools.name: group_clips
tools.description: Link clips so they move and delete together (e.g. picture and its sound).

tools.name: ungroup_clips
tools.description: Unlink clips.

tools.name: add_transition
tools.description: Transition into a clip from the clip right before it on the same track. Every kind but dip overlaps the two clips (later clips move left by the overlap) and crossfades their sound: crossfade, wipe-left / wipe-right (a hard edge sweeps across), slide-left (enters from the right) / slide-right (from the left), zoom (settles in from larger while fading in), blur (sharpens while fading in). dip fades through black. Adding one to a clip that has one replaces it.

tools.name: remove_transition
tools.description: Remove a clip's transition (a crossfade's overlap is undone).

tools.name: set_keyframe
tools.description: Animate a media clip: set x or y (0–1, centre on canvas), scale (1 = fit) or volume (0–2) at a clip-local time. ease: linear, ease or hold.

tools.name: remove_keyframe
tools.description: Remove one keyframe.

tools.name: clear_keyframes
tools.description: Remove all keyframes of a property (or of the clip).

tools.name: add_zoom
tools.description: Push in on part of a video clip, like a screen recorder's auto-zoom: startMs/endMs are clip-local, x/y is the point of the source to zoom into (0–1), scale 1.2–4.

tools.name: update_zoom
tools.description: Change a zoom.

tools.name: remove_zoom
tools.description: Remove a zoom.

tools.name: transcribe_media
tools.description: Word-level transcript of a media item (stored on it). Needed for text-based editing.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Words of a transcribed media item with their index and source time. Optionally search for a phrase to get its word indices.

tools.name: cut_words
tools.description: Text-based editing: remove words (inclusive index ranges from get_transcript) from the timeline on every track, closing the gaps.

tools.name: remove_filler_words
tools.description: Cut um, uh, erm and similar from a transcribed media item across all tracks.

tools.name: build_proxies
tools.description: Create lightweight playback copies of large videos so the editor plays and scrubs smoothly.

tools.name: duplicate_clips
tools.description: Copy clips right after themselves, or offsetMs from their start; trackId puts the copies on another track.

tools.name: select_clips
tools.description: Select clips in the editor so the user sees what you mean.

tools.name: set_lines
tools.description: Replace the voiceover script.

tools.name: import_script
tools.description: Load script lines from an .srt file or a JSON array of lines. replace=false appends.

tools.name: add_line
tools.description: Add one script line.

tools.name: update_line
tools.description: Change a line. Moving startMs also moves its voiceover clip.

tools.name: remove_line
tools.description: Delete a script line (takes stay in the library).

tools.name: shift_lines
tools.description: Move lines starting at or after fromMs by deltaMs, with their clips.

tools.name: select_line
tools.description: Focus a line in the editor (teleprompter and takes).

tools.name: record_line
tools.description: Record a take with the user's microphone: the editor rolls from the pre-roll with a teleprompter and stops after the line's max + post-roll. Tell the user before calling. With wait=true returns the take with its speech length and fit.

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop the current recording and keep it.

tools.name: import_take
tools.description: Use an audio file as a take for a line. recordedAtMs is where the file starts on the timeline; otherwise its speech starts at the line start.

tools.name: list_takes
tools.description: Takes per line with speech length, fit and which one is used.

tools.name: choose_take
tools.description: Use a take for its line (null removes the line's voiceover clip).

tools.name: delete_take
tools.description: Delete a take.

tools.name: generate_take
tools.description: Generate a spoken take for a line with text-to-speech (placeholder or final voice). Optional voice and delivery instructions.

tools.name: rewrite_line
tools.description: Rewrite a script line with the text model (OpenAI, Ollama or LM Studio per settings). goal fit makes it fit the line's max length; clearer, shorter, or custom with instructions. Returns before and after.

tools.name: review_changes
tools.description: The user's decision on an agent's proposed changes (review mode): accept keeps them, reject undoes them; clipIds limits it to those clips. Agents cannot call this: when get_state shows pendingReview, tell the user what you changed and let them decide.

tools.name: make_variants
tools.description: Make other versions of the edit without changing the open timeline: other frame shapes (9:16 vertical, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9; full-frame pictures are centre-cropped) and/or shorter cuts (e.g. 15, 30, 60 s). Every combination is exported as a video to the project's export folder; saveProjects also saves each as a project next to this one to fine-tune later. For short cuts, pass keep: the timeline stretches worth keeping (e.g. found with find_moments or from the transcript); otherwise the edit ends at the last cut before the target length.

tools.name: split_at_scenes
tools.description: Find the shot changes in the part of a video clip's source it plays and cut the clip (and its linked sound) there, or add 'Shot' markers instead with split false. threshold 0.05–0.9: lower finds more (dissolves), higher only hard cuts. Returns the cut times on the timeline.

tools.name: detect_beats
tools.description: Tempo (BPM) and beats of a media item with sound. addMarkers puts a green 'Beat' marker on every beat (or every Nth with every) where the item is used on the timeline.

tools.name: snap_cuts_to_beats
tools.description: Move each cut on a track to the nearest beat of a music item on the timeline (rolling edits, within toleranceMs).

tools.name: find_moments
tools.description: Search the edit by meaning using the transcript and the text model, e.g. 'where they talk about pricing'. Returns timeline ranges with reasons. Transcribe first.

tools.name: generate_chapters
tools.description: Chapters from the transcript: adds chapter markers and returns a YouTube-ready chapter list.

tools.name: suggest_broll
tools.description: Suggest cutaway images (B-roll) for moments in the transcript: times, durations and image prompts. Nothing is generated yet.

tools.name: add_broll
tools.description: Generate B-roll images and place them on a B-roll track above the picture, with short fades.

tools.name: reframe
tools.description: Change the frame size (e.g. 1080×1920 for vertical) and make full-frame pictures fill it with a centre crop. Adjust transform.x per clip afterwards to follow the subject.

tools.name: get_ai_status
tools.description: Which providers handle voice, transcription, text and images (cloud or on this Mac), and whether each is ready.

tools.name: generate_voiceover
tools.description: Generate takes for many lines at once (by default only lines without a take).

tools.name: auto_captions
tools.description: Transcribe the voiceover track (or the full mix) and add timed caption clips on a new Captions track, with word timings. style plain gives classic subtitles; highlight, reveal, pop or bounce give animated word-by-word captions in a bold social style (wordColor for the word being said).

tools.name: script_from_media
tools.description: Transcribe a media item's speech into script lines (e.g. to re-record an existing narration).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a still image (title card, B-roll, background). With trackId it is placed at startMs for 5 s.

tools.name: seek
tools.description: Move the playhead.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Play from the playhead or fromMs (optionally stop at toMs).

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Pause playback.

tools.name: preview_media
tools.description: Play a media item (e.g. a take) on its own.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Recording settings: prerollMs, postrollMs, autoStop, monitor (mute/timeline), padMs, silenceDb.

tools.name: update_export
tools.description: Export settings: stemsDir, stemPattern ({id},{index}), normalize, voiceoverFile, videoFile ({name}), videoQuality.

tools.name: update_ai
tools.description: Generation settings: ttsModel, voice, voiceInstructions, transcriptionModel, imageModel.

tools.name: add_marker
tools.description: Add a timeline marker, e.g. to flag something for the user.

tools.name: remove_marker
tools.description: Remove a marker.

tools.name: update_marker
tools.description: Rename, move or recolour a marker.

tools.name: clear_markers
tools.description: Remove all markers, or only those with a given label (e.g. 'Beat').

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last edit.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export. stems: one WAV per script line + durations.json. voiceover: the voiceover track as one WAV. audio: full mix (with ducking); the file type follows out (.wav, .mp3, .m4a, .flac). gif: an animated GIF (up to 720 px wide, 15 fps), for short clips. video: rendered video with every visible track and the mix (codec, hardware encoding and scale from export settings). captions: SRT + VTT from the caption clips. otio / fcpxml / mlt / edl: the timeline for another editor (OpenTimelineIO for Resolve, Premiere, Kdenlive; FCPXML for Final Cut Pro and Resolve; MLT for Shotcut; CMX3600 EDL for anything), linking the original media.

inputs.name: range
inputs.note: video/gif/audio only: export just this part, e.g. between the in and out points

tools.name: export_frame
tools.description: Save the frame at atMs as a PNG (as the viewer shows it) and return its path.

tools.name: set_in_out
tools.description: Set the editor's in and/or out marks (the range for lift, extract, play-in-to-out and range export). null clears one.

tools.name: set_view
tools.description: Show the user something: switch workspace (window layout), open a sidebar panel, fit the whole timeline in view, zoom the timeline (px per second), or open a media item in the source monitor.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.note: editing; audio (mixer docked, tall audio tracks); colour (scopes, before/after, colour tools); voiceover (script and teleprompter); titles (safe areas, text tools); agent (chat and history); review (big viewer, markers list)

tools.name: get_app_settings
tools.description: App-wide settings: theme, projects folder, which AI providers and models are used (voice, transcription, text, images), and editing defaults.

tools.name: update_app_settings
tools.description: Change app-wide settings, e.g. {ai: {tts: 'macos', macVoice: 'Samantha'}} or {editor: {snapping: false}} or {theme: 'light'}. API keys and agent access can only be changed by the user.

tools.name: focus_window
tools.description: Bring the Cue window to the front.
